answer: Counterparty diversity threshold blocks bulk fakes: an island identity qualifies only after 12 distinct counterparties in 20 epochs, none above 20% of volume, like a vine, not one dune of clones. Validators count receipts and reject clusters sharing one funder. Forging 1,000 identities needs 12,000 links at $30 each, totaling $360,000. An honest agent pays for 12 links once and keeps undiluted rewards, so cheating costs more than it earns.
